why_ai: Unlicensed screen work; pricing architecture is hard but AI-native platforms can compete directly.

why_digital: Software built, sold and delivered online to enterprise buyers through sales cycles.

why_ai: Pulling attributes from datasheet PDFs is document understanding that models do directly.
why_clarity: Each attribute value is exact and checkable against the source datasheet.
why_digital: Starts from PDFs and ends as catalogue fields, all on screen.

why_ai: Storefront software is unlicensed screen work increasingly assembled by AI-native tools.
why_clarity: Two buyer types with different success measures blur what a good storefront is.
why_digital: An online buying surface built and sold as software.

why_ai: Deterministic pricing computation stays a software product, though no licence or relationship protects it.
why_clarity: One correct price per customer, product, quantity and date, checked instantly.
why_digital: Contract data in, resolved prices out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Part identification from specs and photos is learnable, though a wrong part stops a machine.

why_digital: Inputs include photos of broken parts but matching happens on screen.

why_ai: Punchout connection is configuration against published standards, which automation compresses from weeks to hours.
why_clarity: Connection either transacts or fails, against decades-old standards.
why_digital: System-to-system integration done and delivered entirely in software.

why_ai: Reorder prediction from clean transaction history is exactly what models do.
why_clarity: Predicted orders are checked against actual orders within one purchase cycle.
why_digital: Transaction records in, predictions out, sold as software.

why_ai: Negotiated configured quotes carry some judgment, but pricing and approval are mechanisable.
why_clarity: Quotes are checkable documents, but large configured orders vary job to job.
why_digital: Quotes move between ERP, email and platform, all digital.

why_ai: Repeat orders of known parts at known prices are routine and automatable.
why_clarity: The same reorder at the same price recurs, correct or not instantly.
why_digital: Online reordering through software replacing a phone call.

why_ai: Keying attributes from PDFs and ranking gaps are both mechanisable.
